scope: Real Android native Canvas output from CI; fixture tasks, not current private task status or a MIUI device screenshot
reviewer: parent assistant native vision, full images plus component-region crops
observations: Chinese task names, status dots, percentages and footer are legible; no overlapping or off-canvas text was observed.
Running/blocked/waiting/incident dots match the fixture; unknown progress is an em dash with an empty track, not an estimated percentage.
4x4 and 2x4 show eight rows. 4x2 shows four cards and a remaining-four notice; 2x2 shows two and a remaining-six notice.
Narrow versions intentionally show the line label rather than long notes; wider versions show line and note.
Empty and partial lists do not add fake task rows, and their footer remains inside the image.
4x4 host image progress fill was measured independently per row: 37,64,0,18,80,92,100 and unquantified zero, with expected rounding.
device_acceptance: Not performed; user installs and pins to MIUI minus-one screen.
